title: Karen Reed — retirement planning intake
content:
Client: Karen Reed, age 61, recently retired executive. Karen is unmarried and has no children. She has approximately $2.4 million across an employer retirement plan, an IRA and a brokerage account.

Meeting priorities: turn savings into regular income, budget for healthcare, prepare for potential long-term care costs and review legacy plans. Karen is concerned about outliving her savings.

Follow-up: gather plan and investment statements for the review. Confirm residential address documentation for the proposed new brokerage account, and check whether a signed authorization to share investment records with her accountant is on file.
